claims.quote: Type locality is given by Jerdon as 'Cavery River at Seringapatam' which corresponds to Srirangapatna in Karnataka state, southwestern India, a town located on an island completely enclosed by the Cauvery/Kaveri River.

regions.name: Cauvery
regions.quote: Current knowledge suggests it may now be restricted to the upper Cauvery in the vicinity of Coorg, aka Kodagu, Karnataka, plus the upper Tungabhadra River system further north, the latter a tributary within the Krishna watershed and in its lower reaches one of the most polluted rivers in India.
